name: Tenants
description: Connect multiple standalone RMM backends (companies, departments) and switch between them directly in the main RMM. Each tenant is completely separate (its own DB, settings, permissions, spaces, agents). Per-user credentials per tenant; switch straight into a tenant's dashboard via the app (auto-login, open windows are kept). Configure which user/group may see a tenant. Optional pairing with confirmation (tenant-link): a paired tenant must approve this RMM before it can be opened. The active tenant's spaces/files also appear in your own Explorer/Spaces.
author: BYTERA
